cues.en: Hello, everybody. In this video, we are going to be discussing how to use NanoBanana from Google to generate images using the Microsoft Asian Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，這支影片要介紹如何透過 Microsoft Agent Framework，使用 Google 的 Nano Banana 生成圖片。

cues.en: Without further ado, let me get into the code first, and then I'm going to explain a couple of things about NanoBanana that we need to be really aware of.
cues.zh: 不多說，先來看程式碼，接著會說明使用 Nano Banana 時，幾個必須留意的地方。

cues.en: I have a project in here.
cues.zh: 這裡已經有一個專案。

cues.en: The only really important thing that I'm bringing in is a NuGet package that's called Google underscore generative AI.Microsoft, and that is currently at version 3.6.8.
cues.zh: 最重要的是加入名為 Google_GenerativeAI.Microsoft 的 NuGet 套件，目前版本是 3.6.8。

cues.en: By the time you see this video, maybe they have a newer one, but this is the one I'm going to be using in here to be able to communicate directly with Google models.
cues.zh: 等你看到這支影片時，也許已經有更新版本，但這裡會先使用這個版本，直接與 Google 模型通訊。

cues.en: We're going to use two different models in this video, one for NanoBanana 2 and one for NanoBanana Pro.
cues.zh: 這支影片會使用兩種不同模型，一種是 Nano Banana 2，另一種是 Nano Banana Pro。

cues.en: We will see the difference in when to use one versus the other and what do you get out of it as well.
cues.zh: 我們會看看什麼情況適合使用哪一種，以及兩者各自能提供什麼結果。

cues.en: Remember, the Google models are not available in Microsoft Foundry, so I'm not going through Microsoft Foundry.
cues.zh: 記得，Microsoft Foundry 裡沒有提供 Google 模型，所以這裡不會經由 Microsoft Foundry。

cues.en: I'm going directly against Google.
cues.zh: 而是直接連接 Google。

cues.en: You need to go to the AI studio for the Google website and be able to create an account if you don't have one.
cues.zh: 你需要前往 Google AI Studio 網站；如果還沒有帳號，就先建立一個。

cues.en: Maybe you need to put a couple of dollars into the account as well.
cues.zh: 也許還需要在帳戶裡儲值一些金額。

cues.en: Sometimes when you start a brand new account, they will give you a few dollars to play around with these models.
cues.zh: 有時剛建立新帳號，平台會提供一些額度，讓你試用這些模型。

cues.en: But if not, if you have the account for a while now, just go ahead and make sure it's not zero because it has zero amount of the account.
cues.zh: 但如果沒有，或你的帳號已經用了很久，就要確認餘額不是零。因為如果帳戶沒有額度，

cues.en: You won't be able to make any calls because it does cost money actually to generate these images.
cues.zh: 就無法發出請求，畢竟生成這些圖片確實需要費用。

cues.en: Half a dollar, a quarter, stuff like that for these images and we will talk about the cost and which one is better and things like that.
cues.zh: 例如每張幾角美元，後面也會討論費用，以及哪一種更適合。

cues.en: Here I am in my account.
cues.zh: 這裡是我的帳號。

cues.en: If you go to aistudio.google.com, you'll notice I can go to the playground and try to create images myself using the playground and so on.
cues.zh: 前往 aistudio.google.com，可以進入 Playground，直接在介面上試著建立圖片。

cues.en: But what I'm interested in is to go to the dashboard and then you click on the API keys.
cues.zh: 但這裡我要先到 Dashboard，再點選 API keys。

cues.en: Go ahead and create an API key for yourself.
cues.zh: 接著為自己建立 API 金鑰。

cues.en: I created one for me here.
cues.zh: 我已經在這裡建立了一把。

cues.en: You have to have a billing tier associated with it.
cues.zh: 它必須關聯到相應的付費層級，

cues.en: It cannot be at zero.
cues.zh: 帳戶額度不能是零。

cues.en: If I go to billing, I think I have about $20 into this account in here that I've actually been using and I have $19.45 left.
cues.zh: 到 Billing 看看，我記得原本儲值約 20 美元，使用之後，目前還剩 19.45 美元。

cues.en: I think this is more than enough to be able to use the system.
cues.zh: 我想這已經很夠用來操作這個系統。

cues.en: Back into my code, you need to save that valuable API key that you got from Google.
cues.zh: 回到程式碼，要先妥善保存從 Google 取得的 API 金鑰。

cues.en: Once you copy it, you can actually put it straight in the code, which I do not recommend, of course.
cues.zh: 複製後，雖然可以直接放進程式碼，但我當然不建議這樣做。

cues.en: You can put it in the key vault and just make a call to get it from the Azure key vault.
cues.zh: 可以放進 Key Vault，再呼叫 Azure Key Vault 讀取。

cues.en: If you're just in development, maybe the best way to do it is to use the user secrets that come with .NET.
cues.zh: 如果只是開發階段，也許最方便的方法是使用 .NET 的使用者祕密。

cues.en: You can actually right-click on your Nano Banana demo, and there'll be something called manage user secrets that will bring up your secrets.json file.
cues.zh: 在 Nano Banana Demo 專案上按右鍵，選擇 Manage User Secrets，就會開啟 secrets.json。

cues.en: Just create a key and just paste your API key right inside of there, and I'll show you how to use it from the code in here in a second.
cues.zh: 建立一個設定項目，再將 API 金鑰貼進去；稍後會示範如何從程式碼讀取。

cues.en: Or worst case scenario, you just create it as an environment variable on your Windows machine, and then you can actually load the environment variable and being able to use it in the code as well.
cues.zh: 或者，也可以在 Windows 電腦上建立環境變數，再於程式中載入使用。

cues.en: There are so many different ways you can use that API key.
cues.zh: 有很多不同方式可以管理這把 API 金鑰。

cues.en: Sounds good? Let's go back.
cues.zh: 清楚嗎？我們回來。

cues.en: I'm going to go ahead and delete this file because I already generated the image, but I'm going to delete it.
cues.zh: 這個檔案是之前生成的圖片，我先把它刪除。

cues.en: Let's go back here and take a look at the code.
cues.zh: 回到這裡看看程式碼。

cues.en: Bear with me here. We need to explain a couple of things.
cues.zh: 請稍微耐心一點，有幾個地方需要說明。

cues.en: I created my secret in the .NET user secrets.
cues.zh: 我已經在 .NET 使用者祕密中建立設定，

cues.en: I called it Google colon API key.
cues.zh: 名稱是 Google:ApiKey。

cues.en: Then I said equals and I pasted the API key exactly the same way I got it.
cues.zh: 然後將取得的 API 金鑰原樣填入。

cues.en: Then I'm going to start with the first model, which is a Gemini 3, one flash image.
cues.zh: 接著，先從第一個模型 Gemini 3.1 Flash Image 開始。

cues.en: That's the one that has Nano Banana 2 inside of it.
cues.zh: 這個模型使用的就是 Nano Banana 2。

cues.en: Once we run it once, we're going to run it one more time by removing this and actually using another different model called Gemini 3 Pro image and that has the Nano Banana Pro.
cues.zh: 執行一次之後，會再改用另一個模型 Gemini 3 Pro Image，也就是 Nano Banana Pro，再執行一次。

cues.en: As long as you have a couple of dollars into the account, you'd be able to use both of them and I think you'd be okay with that.
cues.zh: 只要帳戶裡有一些可用額度，這兩種模型都能使用，應該沒有問題。

cues.en: Unlike the other videos that we have done, we're not going as OpenAI or Microsoft Foundry or anything like that.
cues.zh: 這次與其他影片不同，不是直接存取 OpenAI 或 Microsoft Foundry。

cues.en: We're going against the generative AI chat client coming directly from Google, passing that API key we just got and passing the model.
cues.zh: 而是使用 Google 提供的 GenerativeAIChatClient，傳入剛才取得的 API 金鑰，以及模型名稱。

cues.en: Like I said, I'm starting with Gemini 3, one flash so I can try Nano Banana 2, which is the cheaper one.
cues.zh: 如同剛才所說，我先從 Gemini 3.1 Flash 開始，試試比較便宜的 Nano Banana 2。

cues.en: You might be asking, for instance, which one is better?
cues.zh: 你可能會問，哪個比較好？

cues.en: Actually, a lot of people think Pro is better.
cues.zh: 很多人其實以為 Pro 一定比較好。

cues.en: Well, a lot of things actually, the regular one, the cheaper one, Nano Banana 2 is better.
cues.zh: 但在不少事情上，標準版、也就是比較便宜的 Nano Banana 2，反而更適合。

cues.en: There is no such thing that if you have the money, just go straight for Nano Banana Pro.
cues.zh: 並不是只要有預算，就一定直接選 Nano Banana Pro。

cues.en: There is definitely a distinction between the two and both of them are extremely useful.
cues.zh: 兩者確實有所區別，而且都很實用。

cues.en: I'll say, for instance, for Nano Banana 2, the generation is very fast.
cues.zh: 例如，Nano Banana 2 的生成速度非常快，

cues.en: It happens between four to eight seconds and you can measure all that stuff, of course, with a stopwatch in your code.
cues.zh: 大約四到八秒，當然也可以在程式碼裡用 Stopwatch 測量。

cues.en: Whatever image, it's not going to be 100 percent accurate.
cues.zh: 不過，生成結果不一定能百分之百精準符合要求。

cues.en: If you're very picky about what needs to show up and all the properties of the image, maybe Pro is better for you, but Nano Banana 2 is very fast, four to eight minutes.
cues.zh: 如果你對圖片細節與各種屬性要求很高，也許 Pro 比較適合；但 Nano Banana 2 很快，大約四到八秒。

cues.en: Nano Banana Pro will take between 10 to 20 seconds sometimes to do it.
cues.zh: Nano Banana Pro 有時則需要十到二十秒。

cues.en: Also, the price is right.
cues.zh: 另外，價格也很實惠。

cues.en: Nano Banana is about eight cents for the image, and that actually makes it two to three times faster than using Nano Banana Pro.
cues.zh: Nano Banana 每張圖片大約八美分，生成速度也大約比 Nano Banana Pro 快兩到三倍。

cues.en: But again, if you are very picky about things that will show up in the picture and you will give it a lot of description and you want it to follow exactly what the text prompt that you're asking,
cues.zh: 但再次提醒，如果你對圖片裡的各項細節很挑剔，會提供大量描述，而且希望它精確遵循文字提示詞，

cues.en: maybe Nano Banana Pro is the best thing for you.
cues.zh: 也許 Nano Banana Pro 更適合你。

cues.en: But Nano Banana Pro is 15 cents for every picture, all right?
cues.zh: 不過，Nano Banana Pro 每張圖片大約十五美分。

cues.en: This can add up pretty quickly and almost half the price to use Nano Banana, and it actually does an excellent job as well, so I put that in mind as well.
cues.zh: 費用很快就會累積。Nano Banana 幾乎只要一半價格，而且效果也很好，這點也值得納入考量。

cues.en: As far as the quality, both of them have very, very high quality, as a matter of fact, so you might want to think about that.
cues.zh: 至於品質，其實兩者的品質都非常高，選擇時也要想想這些差異。

cues.en: All right, so before I actually call my agent, notice here I'm going to create an agent.
cues.zh: 好，在呼叫代理程式之前，注意這裡，我要先建立代理程式。

cues.en: I'm going to call it agent, and I'll need to pass it some chat client agent options like we did with other models before.
cues.zh: 變數就叫 agent，並傳入 ChatClientAgentOptions，和之前使用其他模型時一樣。

cues.en: I'm going to give it a name.
cues.zh: 先給它一個名稱，

cues.en: We can call it whatever we want.
cues.zh: 名稱可以自行決定。

cues.en: I call it image generator, and then I'm going to be passing a chat options in here.
cues.zh: 我叫它 Image Generator，接著傳入 ChatOptions。

cues.en: What is this chat option?
cues.zh: 這個 ChatOptions 是什麼？

cues.en: As you can see in here, the chat option in the agent framework has additional properties that you can actually create a dictionary out of it,
cues.zh: 可以看到，Agent Framework 的 ChatOptions 有 AdditionalProperties，可以建立一個字典來放額外設定，

cues.en: and with the Nano Banana, with these models for Gemini 3 One Flash image and the Gemini 3 Pro image, all of them have these properties available for them.
cues.zh: Nano Banana 對應的 Gemini 3.1 Flash Image 與 Gemini 3 Pro Image，都能使用這些屬性。

cues.en: One is a list of modality.
cues.zh: 其中一項是模態清單。

cues.en: Maybe the model that you're working with can only work with text, so I'm going to say I'm only interested in modality text and the modality image.
cues.zh: 也許你使用的模型只能處理文字；而我這裡要指定，只對文字與圖片這兩種模態有興趣。

cues.en: If you want to see what else is available, go ahead and put after the dot, do a control space on the code, and you'll notice that I can bring in modality for audio,
cues.zh: 如果想看看還有哪些選項，可以在點號後按 Ctrl+Space，就會看到還能指定音訊模態，

cues.en: for wave files, documents, image, modality unspecified.
cues.zh: 例如 WAV 音檔，還有文件、圖片，或未指定模態。

cues.en: If you don't know, maybe at runtime, a tool will bring in the specification from the modality, or a text or a video.
cues.zh: 如果事先不知道，也可能在執行時由工具提供模態資訊。另外也可以指定文字或影片。

cues.en: All of these things are available for you.
cues.zh: 這些選項都可以使用。

cues.en: In my case in here, I'm only interested in text and images only.
cues.zh: 在這個範例中，我只需要文字與圖片。

cues.en: And then you get to specify the image configuration for the aspect ratio.
cues.zh: 接著可以在圖片設定中指定長寬比。

cues.en: This is another thing that you really need to be aware of.
cues.zh: 這又是一項必須留意的差異。

cues.en: There are 10 of them for Nano Banana Pro.
cues.zh: Nano Banana Pro 有十種比例，

cues.en: So Nano Banana Pro have 10 of them.
cues.zh: 也就是說，Pro 提供十種選擇。

cues.en: Believe it or not, Nano Banana 2, the cheaper one, has actually more than 10.
cues.zh: 但比較便宜的 Nano Banana 2，居然比十種還多，

cues.en: It has 14 different native aspect ratios.
cues.zh: 總共有十四種原生長寬比。

cues.en: So you can get the one-on-one, which I'm using here.
cues.zh: 例如我這裡使用的 1:1，

cues.en: This is going to give you the image in a square, for instance.
cues.zh: 會產生正方形圖片。

cues.en: I can do a 16 to 9 if I would need a widescreen.
cues.zh: 需要寬螢幕時，可以用 16:9。

cues.en: I can do 21 to 9, which is also ultra-wide.
cues.zh: 也可以用 21:9，這是超寬比例。

cues.en: I can do 9, 16 vertical if you're using that for YouTube or TikTok or something like that.
cues.zh: 如果是 YouTube、TikTok 等直式內容，也可以用 9:16。

cues.en: And also there are other ones, weird, but they are available, 2 to 3, 3 to 2, 3 to 4, 4 to 3, 4 to 5, and 5 to 4.
cues.zh: 另外還有其他比例，雖然比較特殊，但也有提供，包括 2:3、3:2、3:4、4:3、4:5，以及 5:4。

cues.en: Nano Banana 2, the cheaper one, have all of these, but it has even more that the Pro one does not have.
cues.zh: 比較便宜的 Nano Banana 2 不只擁有這些比例，還有 Pro 沒有的額外選項。

cues.en: It's like 4 to 1 for wide panoramic view.
cues.zh: 例如寬幅全景的 4:1，

cues.en: It also has 8 to 1 for ultra-wide panoramic view.
cues.zh: 以及超寬全景的 8:1。

cues.en: It has 1 to 4 for making it a portrait and 1 to 8.
cues.zh: 也有直式的 1:4 和 1:8。

cues.en: So it reverses the wide and the ultra-wide for portrait and for landscape as well.
cues.zh: 也就是將寬幅與超寬幅的比例反轉，同時提供直式與橫式選擇。

cues.en: These are four that are available in Nano Banana 2, not available in the Pro, okay?
cues.zh: 這四種是 Nano Banana 2 才有、Pro 沒有的。

cues.en: The other 10 are available for both.
cues.zh: 其餘十種則兩者都有。

cues.en: And then the final thing is the image size.
cues.zh: 最後一項是圖片尺寸。

cues.en: And by the way, there are more properties.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，還有更多屬性可以設定。

cues.en: Please feel free to click on the additional property dictionary, click control and go see all the properties available that you can actually call on the Gemini 3.1 flash image in the Pro.
cues.zh: 你可以按住 Ctrl，點進 AdditionalProperties 字典相關的定義，看看 Gemini 3.1 Flash Image 與 Pro 還提供哪些屬性。

cues.en: The last one is the image size.
cues.zh: 最後這裡設定的是圖片尺寸。

cues.en: It could be 1K, it could be 2K, or it could be 4K.
cues.zh: 可以是 1K、2K，或 4K。

cues.en: Both models will support it, okay?
cues.zh: 這兩個模型都支援。

cues.en: Except the 4K are pretty expensive.
cues.zh: 但 4K 的費用比較高，

cues.en: So you need to really make a decision why you want to use a 4K.
cues.zh: 所以必須先想清楚，為什麼需要使用 4K。

cues.en: If it's something just running thumbnails or something, it might not be worth it.
cues.zh: 如果只是做縮圖等用途，可能就不太值得。

cues.en: As a matter of fact, the Nano Banana 2 only, okay, not the Pro one, has an extra one, which is 0.5K.
cues.zh: 其實只有 Nano Banana 2，也就是非 Pro 版本，另外提供 0.5K。

cues.en: That means it can create a picture for you at 512 pixels.
cues.zh: 也就是可以產生 512 像素的圖片。

cues.en: Low resolution, but maybe you just need an icon or you need a thumbnail and you don't want to spend too much money.
cues.zh: 雖然解析度低，但如果只是需要圖示或縮圖，不想花太多錢，

cues.en: It would be dirt cheap to use it that way.
cues.zh: 這種方式的費用就很低。

cues.en: I'm here using 2K to get a very nice looking image, but you don't need to do that.
cues.zh: 這裡我會用 2K，取得比較精緻的圖片，但你不一定要這樣選。

cues.en: Remember, 1K, 2K, and 4K are available in both, and 0.5K is available only on the Nano Banana 2 if you'd like to use that as well. Sounds good?
cues.zh: 記得，1K、2K 與 4K 兩者都能用；0.5K 則只有 Nano Banana 2 提供，有需要也可以選。清楚嗎？

cues.en: These are my options.
cues.zh: 這些就是我的設定選項。

cues.en: This is what I'm going to be telling the system that I'd like to generate the image with.
cues.zh: 我要透過這些設定，告訴系統如何生成圖片。

cues.en: And now that I've created my agent, the only thing left is for us to ask a question, right?
cues.zh: 代理程式已經建立好了，接下來只剩下提出要求，對吧？

cues.en: So I'm going to run on the sync here in the agent framework, saying create an image of a cute Heavenese dog, all right?
cues.zh: 這裡透過 Agent Framework 呼叫 RunAsync，要求：「生成一張可愛的哈瓦那犬圖片。」

cues.en: So my dog would be very happy about that.
cues.zh: 我的狗一定會很開心。

cues.en: And like we did before, if you've seen in other videos, how we did it with the OpenAI and Azure OpenAI, because they are different, I want to see what is the difference, for instance,
cues.zh: 如果你看過之前使用 OpenAI 與 Azure OpenAI 的影片，就會知道兩者做法有差異。因此，我也想知道，

cues.en: when I try to get a response from Google Nano Banana 2 or Nano Banana Pro, how different is it going to be?
cues.zh: 改成取得 Google Nano Banana 2 或 Nano Banana Pro 的回應時，又會有多大差別？

cues.en: It's not going to be really that different.
cues.zh: 其實差異沒有那麼大。

cues.en: Remember, it's going to have to get into all the messages inside of the response coming, and each message will have a lot of different contents probably.
cues.zh: 記得，必須走訪回應裡的所有訊息，而且每則訊息可能都有多種不同內容。

cues.en: Some of that content will be text.
cues.zh: 有些內容會是文字，

cues.en: Some of it will be data content.
cues.zh: 有些則是 DataContent，

cues.en: It will contain the image itself.
cues.zh: 裡面包含圖片本身。

cues.en: I might be interested in both, okay?
cues.zh: 這兩種內容我可能都想處理。

cues.en: So remember, the model might return some text as well, not just the image, all right?
cues.zh: 所以要記得，模型也可能傳回文字，而不只是圖片。

cues.en: So in here, I'm going through the entire loops of all the messages and all the contents inside of every single message until I see a text content, and then I'm going to write it out for you so you can see it.
cues.zh: 這裡會透過迴圈，走訪每則訊息及其所有內容；如果發現 TextContent，就把它印出來，讓你看到。

cues.en: Sometimes it doesn't return any text, and that's fine.
cues.zh: 有時不會傳回任何文字，這也沒關係，

cues.en: I'm really just interested in the image.
cues.zh: 因為我真正想要的是圖片。

cues.en: But some models will return some text explaining something in the image that got created for you.
cues.zh: 但有些模型也會傳回文字，解釋生成圖片中的內容。

cues.en: And then I'm going to check if the item in the content that came back is of type data content.
cues.zh: 接著會檢查傳回的內容項目是不是 DataContent。

cues.en: If it is of data content, I'm expecting this to be the image.
cues.zh: 如果是，就預期它包含圖片。

cues.en: So I want to make sure to look into that data content and find out what MIME type it is.
cues.zh: 因此，我會查看這個 DataContent，確認它的 MIME 類型。

cues.en: So I'm going to look for the image.media type, and I'm going to see if it says image slash PNG or image slash JPEG or image slash WebP.
cues.zh: 也就是讀取圖片的 MediaType，看看是 image/png、image/jpeg，還是 image/webp。

cues.en: And what I'm doing in this code in here is that I'm trying to just create an extension.
cues.zh: 這段程式碼的目的是決定檔案副檔名。

cues.en: So if the MIME type comes back from the Google call and it found the PNG, I want to actually create an extension.
cues.zh: 如果 Google 呼叫傳回的 MIME 類型是 PNG，我就使用對應的副檔名，

cues.en: It's called .PNG.
cues.zh: 也就是 .png。

cues.en: What happens if it created a different kind, like a GIF that I didn't ask for or some kind of extension of an image that I've never heard about?
cues.zh: 如果它生成的是其他類型，例如我沒要求的 GIF，或某種我從沒聽過的圖片格式，該怎麼辦？

cues.en: Well, I'm doing a catch all in here.
cues.zh: 這裡也有一個涵蓋其他情況的處理方式，

cues.en: I'm just going to put the binary in a file called .bin, and I'm going to figure it out later on.
cues.zh: 直接將二進位資料存成 .bin 檔案，之後再判斷。

cues.en: I'm going to go ahead and ask maybe Gemini to tell me what the heck that is.
cues.zh: 也許我還會請 Gemini 幫忙辨識那到底是什麼。

cues.en: But these are the three that I'm interested in right now, PNG, JPEG, and WebP. Sounds good?
cues.zh: 但目前主要處理的就是 PNG、JPEG 和 WebP 這三種。這樣清楚嗎？

cues.en: And then finally, the last two lines of code, I'm going to look for where my project is, which is called 42-nanobanana-demo.
cues.zh: 最後幾行程式碼會找出專案所在的位置，專案名稱是 42-NanoBanana-Demo。

cues.en: I'm going to get the current directory, and I'm going to generate that image and give it a name.
cues.zh: 取得目前的工作目錄，再替生成的圖片決定檔案名稱。

cues.en: We'll call it generated-1, for instance.
cues.zh: 例如取名為 generated-1。

cues.en: And because I'm only generating one image, it will always be generated-1.
cues.zh: 因為目前只生成一張圖片，所以名稱會一直是 generated-1。

cues.en: But if my code in here is generating two or three or four images, then I can create a counter.
cues.zh: 但如果程式會生成兩、三、四張圖片，就可以建立計數器。

cues.en: See the integer saved equals to zero.
cues.zh: 看這裡的整數變數 saved，初始值為零，

cues.en: I'm going to keep generating generated-1, generated-2, generated-3, and so on.
cues.zh: 之後依序產生 generated-1、generated-2、generated-3 等名稱。

cues.en: In our case in here, it will only be one file, and it will have the extension of whatever the MIME type told me it is, whether it's a PNG, JPEG, or WebP. That's it.
cues.zh: 在這個範例裡只會有一個檔案，副檔名則依 MIME 類型決定，可能是 PNG、JPEG 或 WebP，就是這樣。

cues.en: I'm going to go ahead and write all bytes async, all the base 64 of the image that I already received in the response.
cues.zh: 接著呼叫 WriteAllBytesAsync，將已從回應中收到的圖片資料，

cues.en: I'm going to write it out to that specific folder with a specific file name and extension as well.
cues.zh: 寫到指定資料夾，並使用對應的檔名與副檔名。

cues.en: And of course, if there are no data content at all, I'm going to write out the model return no images, review its text response.
cues.zh: 當然，如果完全沒有 DataContent，就印出：「模型沒有傳回圖片，請查看文字回應。」

cues.en: And sometimes based on your questions, you might not have asked for an image, but it will still respond.
cues.zh: 有時候，依你提出的問題，也許根本沒有要求圖片，但模型仍然會回答。

cues.en: You're paying way too much money for that text because you didn't ask for an image, but you're still using NanoBanana or something like that, or the Gemini 3, what's the name,
cues.zh: 這樣你其實是在為文字回應支付過高的費用，因為你沒要求生成圖片，卻使用了 Nano Banana，或是 Gemini 3，名稱是

cues.en: 3.1 Flash image or the Pro one as well.
cues.zh: Gemini 3.1 Flash Image，或 Pro 版本。

cues.en: So you have to be very careful with that as well. All right.
cues.zh: 這一點也要特別小心。好，

cues.en: At the end, I wanted to find out how much tokens are we paying for?
cues.zh: 最後我想知道，這次究竟需要支付多少 Token 費用。

cues.en: So we're counting on the input token, the cash token, the output token, the reasoning token, and the total token used for making that call as well.
cues.zh: 因此會統計這次呼叫的輸入 Token、快取 Token、輸出 Token、推理 Token，以及總 Token 用量。

cues.en: All right, let's save all of this.
cues.zh: 好，儲存所有內容。

cues.en: And we'll come back in here, we'll say .NET run.
cues.zh: 回到這裡，執行 dotnet run。

cues.en: And hopefully it will go through all of that.
cues.zh: 希望程式能順利完成這些流程，

cues.en: We'll be able to pick the text and the data image, data content with the image itself, be able to save it.
cues.zh: 取得文字，以及包含圖片本身的 DataContent，並將圖片儲存下來。

cues.en: Hopefully we'll see a file being generated here on the left side within a few seconds, and we'll find out how much money is it going to cost us to do that. There it is.
cues.zh: 希望幾秒鐘後，左側就會出現生成的檔案，也能知道這次花了多少費用。出來了。

cues.en: You see generated-1.jpg got created.
cues.zh: 可以看到已經建立 generated-1.jpg，

cues.en: So it's a JPEG, not a PNG.
cues.zh: 所以是 JPEG，不是 PNG。

cues.en: And notice it's 2,116 tokens that have been spent.
cues.zh: 注意，這次總共使用了 2,116 個 Token。

cues.en: So now if I go back to my aistudio.google.com, I can see within a minute or two, it's not immediate, but it will tell you exactly how much that cost us.
cues.zh: 現在回到 aistudio.google.com，約一、兩分鐘後就能看到費用，不會立刻更新，但會顯示這次實際花了多少。

cues.en: I'd be able to see the charges for that, which in my case in here would probably be something like $0.08 for this guy. Sounds good?
cues.zh: 我就能查看這次收費；以這個例子來說，大約會是 0.08 美元。清楚嗎？

cues.en: Let's go ahead and open up the image and see what we created.
cues.zh: 我們來開啟圖片，看看生成了什麼。

cues.en: And there is my beautiful Havanese dog right there.
cues.zh: 這就是漂亮的哈瓦那犬。

cues.en: Has a 2,000, remember it doesn't bring it per pixel, it does it by 1K, 2K.
cues.zh: 尺寸是約 2K。記得，它不是直接讓你指定逐一的像素尺寸，而是使用 1K、2K 這種級距。

cues.en: So some other tools, they give it to you by 1920, by 1080, gives you by pixels.
cues.zh: 有些工具會讓你指定 1920×1080 這類像素尺寸，

cues.en: This one by 1K, 2K, and 4K, the value of the image itself, all right?
cues.zh: 而這裡是以 1K、2K 與 4K 決定圖片的解析度級距。

cues.en: One last thing I would like to do to see if it would make any difference at all is to go back here and get the pro one.
cues.zh: 最後再做一個測試，看看結果會不會不同：回到這裡，改用 Pro 版本，

cues.en: And we'll copy that and we'll change our model to use the pro one.
cues.zh: 複製它，再將模型改成 Pro。

cues.en: And we'll put that as a V, Control S this guy.
cues.zh: 貼上，按 Ctrl+S 儲存。

cues.en: And I'm going to go ahead and run it one more time and see if it makes any difference.
cues.zh: 接著再執行一次，看看有沒有差異。

cues.en: But again, my questions, what did I do?
cues.zh: 不過，我這裡的問題是，剛才做了什麼？

cues.en: I did something wrong?
cues.zh: 是不是哪裡寫錯了？

cues.en: Let me go back up.
cues.zh: 回到上方看看。

cues.en: Oh, I missed the E, there you go.
cues.zh: 喔，少了一個 e，補上就好。

cues.en: Come in here and say image, Control S.
cues.zh: 這裡要寫 image，再按 Ctrl+S。

cues.en: Let's go ahead and do that one more time.
cues.zh: 我們再執行一次。

cues.en: All right, so now I'm going against the pro one, which will take double the amount of time, 10 to 20 seconds to generate that image, and it will cost me double the amount of money.
cues.zh: 好，現在使用的是 Pro，生成時間大約會加倍，需要十到二十秒，費用也會增加到大約兩倍。

cues.en: Of course, if my text in here is just create an image of a cute Havanese dog, that's a waste of money to do that on a pro.
cues.zh: 當然，如果提示詞只是「生成一張可愛的哈瓦那犬圖片」，用 Pro 就有點浪費錢。

cues.en: If this is like half a page or a full page worth of text that you want to have a dog blue next to the mustache of the dog, and that is when you want to use the pro.
cues.zh: 如果提示詞長達半頁、一頁，而且很精確地要求狗的顏色、鬍鬚旁的各種細節等，這時才比較需要 Pro。

cues.en: But a simple thing like that, you might not need to do something like this at all.
cues.zh: 但像這麼簡單的要求，可能完全不需要這樣做。

cues.en: Even though the tokens are less, but it might actually end up costing more money for doing the pro one.
cues.zh: 即使用掉的 Token 比較少，Pro 最後的實際費用仍然可能更高。

cues.en: And if I go back in here and click on that, that is the image created by the pro versus the one that was created by the Nano Banana 2.
cues.zh: 回到這裡點開，這張是 Pro 生成的，可以與剛才 Nano Banana 2 的圖片比較。

cues.en: Hopefully this was useful to you so you can understand how to deal with that from the Asian framework.
cues.zh: 希望這段內容能幫助你了解，如何透過 Agent Framework 操作這些模型。

cues.en: And I'll see you again in a future video. Thank you.
cues.zh: 我們之後的影片再見，謝謝。
